name: Dedicated Philippine tax & accounting staff for small/mid Illinois CPA firms (managed offshore seats)
summary: Customer = CPA-firm account. Each account rents 1-2+ dedicated, accounting-trained Philippine staff (staff accountant / tax preparer / bookkeeper) billed monthly in advance, with US account management, IRC 7216 consent workflow and an FTC-Safeguards-ready security program. Workers engaged as contractors via a contractor platform at first (EOR only where required). Operating profit is before founder pay.
evidence_notes: Seat prices: CPA-firm-focused provider lists talent cost from $1,400 (US accountant), $2,300 (tax preparer), $2,400 (auditor) plus an undisclosed monthly management fee [B, DG-S002]; generalist managed VA firms $1,500-3,500/seat-month [B, C9-S016/S018/S019]; marketplace salary+$99 seat [B, DG-S007].

Philippine CPA-qualified accountant salary US$1,500-1,900/month per a 2026 vendor salary guide [D, DG-S003]; general VA salaries $500-1,200 [B, DG-S007]. Base worker cost assumes non-CPA accounting staff at ~$1,100 gross plus 13th-month equivalent, stipend, contractor-platform fee.

EOR is $599-699/employee-month [B, DG-S004/S005/S006]; at $2,400/seat an EOR model leaves ~15% gross margin, so the base case uses contractor engagement ($29-49/month platform fee) and treats EOR as the conservative case.
Client churn: no published data (MISSING). Provider worker attrition 22% (2025) vs 50% BPO benchmark [D, DG-S012]; 86% retention claim [D, DG-S013]. Client churn modeled 1.5-4%/month (E).
Funnel conversion rates are analyst estimates (E). Prospect universe: 1,062 active Illinois CPA firm licenses, 680 in the six-county Chicago area [A, DG-S001].

Regulatory: offshore tax-return disclosure needs signed taxpayer consent; SSN disclosure needs adequate data-protection safeguards at both preparers [A, DG-S009]; firms must contractually oversee service providers under 16 CFR 314.4(f) [A, DG-S010]; pay to foreign contractors for work abroad is not US wages / not withheld [A, DG-S011].

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Time to build security policy, 7216 consent templates, contractor agreements and a bench of 3-5 vetted candidates; no licence needed.
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Stage C: 2-6 weeks for owner-operators [E]; CPA firms buy around busy-season planning (Aug-Dec), so 2 months base.
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified conversations with CPA-firm partners/firm administrators from outbound to the 680 Chicago-area licensed firms [A universe, DG-S001] plus ICPAS events; rate is an analyst estimate.
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Analyst estimate; proposal = role profile + candidate shortlist.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Analyst estimate for an unknown entrant against established offshore firms; trial seat lowers friction.
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: Analyst estimate for a hired account executive selling to CPA firms.
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: CPA partners talk to peers (ICPAS chapters, study groups); no measured rate.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: No client-churn data published (MISSING). Worker attrition 22%/yr at a quality provider [D, DG-S012]; month-to-month terms after 90 days are the norm [D, C9-S020]; post-tax-season downsizing adds churn.
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Seats/account x price: cons 1.2 x $2,100; base 1.4 x $2,400; opt 1.6 x $2,700. Prices anchored on $1,400-2,400+ talent cost plus management fee [B, DG-S002] and $1,500-3,500 managed seats [B, C9-S019]; seats/account E.
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Setup/recruiting fee; Stealth Agents charges a one-time setup charge [B, C9-S016]; amount is E; may be waived to compete.
drivers.arpc_annual_growth_pct__source: Seat expansion within accounts plus 2-3% price; analyst estimate.
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Base seat cost ~$1,490: salary $1,100 + 13th-month equivalent $92 + HMO $50 + equipment/security stipend $80 + contractor platform $49 [B, DG-S004] + replacement recruiting $120 (E) vs $2,400 price. Conservative assumes higher salaries and partial EOR at $599 [B, DG-S004/S005].
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: Job posting via OnlineJobs.ph $69-99/mo [B, DG-S008] plus screening time.
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Card/ACH processing, FX spreads, bad debt.
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Trial-seat discount, travel, data tools; analyst estimate.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: ICPAS/CPA-society event fees, LinkedIn, website; analyst estimate.
drivers.dso_days__source: Monthly-in-advance billing is common among VA/offshore staffing firms [E, Stage A/C]; negative DSO = prepaid.
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Covers setup, security tooling and ~6 months of overhead before contribution turns positive.
